body:
### What are you really trying to do?

I want to attach a build id to workers just so we can see what version is running in the temporal UI but I dont want to use all of the worker/workflow versioning stuff yet.

### Describe the bug

`defaultVersioningBehavior` only allows auto upgrade and pinned, not unspecified, which is supported by the server.
https://temporalio.slack.com/archives/C01DKSMU94L/p1773250476620249
